I cannot afford chemical fertilizer for beans when my land is so small and my family depends on what little we have; the soil has always given us something when we add manure from our goats and cow. We will use the seed we kept from last season's harvest and do all the work ourselves—planting, weeding, and harvesting—because paying workers is impossible and the plot is small enough for my wife and children to manage alongside our other fields. I am counting on the rains in Morogoro as I always have, since we have no way to bring water to the plot.
